scope: Only the updated reservation and Donation Guide screens/actions; tests used fictional seeded demo accounts in a disposable SQLite database.

results.request_and_accept_without_appointment: Passed. A recipient request included a proposed date/time; giver acceptance without explicit agreement showed “Reserved — pickup time not yet agreed,” the recipient proposal, the listing availability window, and the general meeting area separately.
results.explicit_appointment_agreement: Passed. Giver explicitly accepted the recipient-proposed Aug 3, 2027 at 15:30 appointment. The accepted card showed it as Pickup appointment and kept the listing availability and general area distinct.
results.role_specific_physical_exchange_confirma: Passed with fictional records. Recipient used “I have received the item.” and giver used “I have handed over the item.” Test database reached completed; test listing quantity became 0 and its need became fulfilled. No physical exchange occurred.
results.success_notification_layout: Passed. Browser geometry check confirmed the notice begins below the header and ends before main content.
results.swap_room_resource: Passed. Donation Guide displayed 533 Prospect Street, basement level; all five commonly exchanged categories; Yale Connect schedule note; contact email; private-housing eligibility confirmation caveat; and no-guaranteed-acceptance wording. Acceptance remained marked as needing verification.
results.legacy_generic_pickup_value: Passed. On a seeded accepted reservation whose legacy pickup_window is the generic value “Afternoons,” the card shows “Reserved — pickup time not yet agreed,” the listing availability window, and the general meeting area without falsely labeling Afternoons as a recipient-proposed appointment.

limitations: The separate real-student usability test remains pending. The browser scenario is a software workflow check in a disposable fictional database, not participant research or a real pickup.
